thread:
auditor-bot: SOC2 auditor asking for evidence pack: 90d CloudTrail + RBAC change log, KMS rotation/key-wrap events for inference CMKs, HSM attestation PDF, vuln triage for CVE-2025-9999 (linked IR-2026-042), Opsgenie alert history, and a signed manifest (SHA256 per file + HMAC with auditor nonce). Delivery requested by 2026-04-20 EOD. Who can own each piece?
morgan: i'll coordinate packaging and produce the signed manifest/custody statement. alex/tara/devon/sam — please confirm ownership.
alex: I can run CloudTrail exports + RBAC timelines. prefer both CSV summary and raw JSON bundle.
tara: I'll pull KMS key metadata, rotation events, and key policy revisions. staging path: s3://evidence/kmsevidence/fieldwork-20260420/
devon: i'll collect HSM vendor attestation and CloudHSM import logs; one CMK uses vendor-wrapped material — will include vendor thumbprint.
sam: i'll assemble vuln triage artifacts for CVE-2025-9999: timeline, PRs, mitigations, regression test SHAs, and link to IR-2026-042. short executive summary + full bundle.
lina: legal - can you prep custody statement template that mentions HMAC key id and auditor nonce requirement?
legal: draft: "Redwood Inference attests custody of the enclosed artifacts from collection through delivery. The manifest is HMAC-SHA256 signed using internal key id=hk-2024-03 and includes the auditor-provided nonce. Contact legal@redwood to verify." good?
morgan: yes. process note: we will compute SHA256 per object, create manifest.json listing {file, size, sha256, s3_key}, then compute HMAC-SHA256(manifest_json, auditor_nonce) and attach custody statement. We'll provide a verify script.
engsec-bot: recommended Splunk filter for RBAC timeline:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=CreateRole OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=DetachRolePolicy
| table _time,userIdentity.arn,eventName,requestParameters,eventID
| where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-90d@d")
```
alex: I'll include eventID in CSV so auditor can cross-check. CloudTrail CLI I'll run for raw KMS events:
```
aws cloudtrail start-export-task --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext --start-time 2026-01-20T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-04-19T23:59:59Z --destination-s3-bucket-name evidence --destination-s3-prefix kms/raw
```
tara: rotation dates: 2026-03-30 and 2025-12-02. I'll include before/after key snapshots and policy revision diffs. note: some principals are redacted in logs; full mapping will be in HSM-protected bundle for auditors under NDA.
ops-bot: presigned link TTL = 7 days. Use `s3-presign --expires 604800`. Tag objects with `checksum-sha256` and `manifest-id`.
morgan: when you upload, include S3 object tags: checksum-sha256 and manifest-id. we'll pick manifest-id=sfw-20260420.
devon: HSM attestation PDF + import logs ETA: 2026-04-16 EOD. will include vendor signature and thumbprint.
alex: RBAC + CloudTrail exports ETA: 2026-04-17 AM. I'll post presigned links here when done.
sam: vuln bundle ETA: 2026-04-15 EOD. will include test SHAs and monitoring diffs.
morgan: I'll assemble manifest 2026-04-18 AM, compute SHA256s, HMAC with auditor nonce once provided, and hand to legal for external delivery sign-off.
lina: auditor: please provide a nonce when you confirm pickup window so we can HMAC the manifest with it.
auditor-bot: nonce will be provided at delivery time. Auditor will verify SHA256 and HMAC upon receipt and may request live verification.
morgan: one more: include Opsgenie alert export for IR-2026-042 (alerts, timestamps, responders). alex — can you pull that too?
alex: yes. Opsgenie -> export incident IR-2026-042 with responder list and escalation timeline. placing in s3://evidence/incidents/IR-2026-042/.
tara: remember to run IAM policy simulation per-CMK for principal sets (`iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy`) to show who would have had Encrypt/Decrypt permissions at dates of interest. auditors prefer simulation + observed events.
morgan: redact personal emails in public CSVs; include redaction mapping in HSM-protected artifact. tag email_redaction=true on affected objects.
legal: i'll sign custody statement after manifest is assembled and nonce applied. include manifest file name like manifest-{nonce}.json.
morgan: final checklist: - RBAC CSV + raw JSON -> alex - KMS rotation + policy snapshots -> tara - HSM attestation + import logs -> devon - Vulnerability triage bundle -> sam - Opsgenie alert history -> alex - Signed manifest + custody statement -> morgan/legal - Pre-review by eng-security -> morgan 2026-04-18 AM.
morgan: escalate to #eng-security with :rotating_light: if any ETA misses. alex/tara/devon/sam post presigned links here when uploads complete so legal can sign and we can deliver.
auditor-bot: acknowledged. Auditor expects delivery by 2026-04-20 EOD and will verify checksums + HMAC. Thanks for coordinating.
